## Discrepancies

### DISC-1: API contract `POST /api/v1/ingestDocuments` does not exist [High]

- **FSD says:** §3.1.6 / §3.2.6 / §3.3.6 / §3.4.6 / §5.1 — a single endpoint
  `POST /api/v1/ingestDocuments` taking `docs[]` (with `path`, `type`, `tags`, `format`) and
  returning `{ success, ingested, converted, skipped, unconvertible }`.
- **Actual codebase:** two endpoints in `backend/src/server/routes/api-index.ts` —
  `POST /api/index/documents` (`{files:[{path,content}]}` → `{indexed, rejected, rejectedReasons}`)
  and `POST /api/index/ingest-docs` (empty body → `{ingested, errors, total, failedFiles}`).
  No `/api/v1/ingestDocuments` route exists anywhere in the backend.
- **Impact:** QA cannot write API tests from the FSD contract; integration docs are wrong; a DEV
  implementing to spec would create a non-existent endpoint.
- **Recommended fix (BA):** rewrite FSD §3.x.6 and §5.1 to the real two-phase contract (see TDD
  Section 3.1/3.2/3.4), including the error envelope `{error, details, action}` and 400/401/403/503
  statuses.

### DISC-2: `tags` passed to ingest are dropped at insert time [High] — ✅ RESOLVED (fix round 1)

- **FSD says:** BR-06/BR-11 — every document must carry at least one tag; `docs[].tags` is an input
  parameter of the ingest contract and tags are attached to the entry (§3.2.4, §4.2 DocEntry
  relationship).
- **Actual codebase (pre fix round 1 — the observation):** `handleIngestDocsFromTemp` correctly
  computes tags (`extractTagsFromPath` → `tags: tags.join(',')`) and passes them to
  `dispatcher.dispatch('mem_ingest_file', {..., tags})`, **but** `handleIngestFile`
  (`backend/src/modules/memory/dispatchers/crud.ts`) never read `a.tags`:
  it inserted with `tags: ''` and enqueued `TAG_ENRICHMENT` with `existing_tags: ''`.
  Effective tags only appeared later via the LLM tag analyzer or `TaskWorker.fallbackTagExtraction`.
- **Impact (pre fix round 1):** Bug #2's fix was only *indirectly* effective (fallback re-derives
  from `payload.source` = temp path; LLM path depends on content). Between insert and enrichment,
  rows had empty tags; if the worker was down, tags stayed empty forever — BR-11 could be violated
  in practice.
- **Recommended fix (BA/DEV):** either (a) honour `a.tags` in `handleIngestFile`
  (`tags: a.tags ?? ''`, also pass as `existing_tags`), or (b) document in FSD that tags are
  async-enriched and BR-11 applies *after* enrichment. Recommend (a).
- **Status — ✅ RESOLVED (dev fix round 1, option (a) implemented), evidence:**
  - `backend/src/modules/memory/dispatchers/crud.ts:262-271` — `a.tags` (array **or** string) is
    normalised and persisted at insert (`engine.insert({ ..., tags })`); the old `tags: ''` literal is gone.
  - `crud.ts:285` — the `TAG_ENRICHMENT` payload carries `existing_tags: tags` **and**
    `source: filePath`, so the dedup merge starts from the caller's tags instead of `''`.
  - `crud.ts:296` — edge extraction receives the same `tags`.
  - `kb-entries.ts:151` (admin re-enrich) now passes `existing_tags: entry.tags ?? ''` (R1) so a
    re-enrich cannot wipe tags persisted at insert.
  - Payload `source` coverage **4/4**: `crud.ts:89`, `crud.ts:285`, `kb-entries.ts:151`,
    `analytics.ts:71` (see DISC-9).
  - **Test evidence (re-run 2026-10-05):** IT
    `backend/src/modules/memory/ingest/__tests__/ingest-file-tags-fallback.it.test.ts` — **3/3 PASS**
    (real dispatcher + adapter + worker on SQLite: insert → fallback enrichment → `tags` contains
    `sa4e` + `sa4e-337`; payload `existing_tags` seeded; re-ingest refreshes & closes the task);
    UT `TaskWorker.fallback-tag.test.ts` — **12/12 PASS** (15/15 combined for both files).
  - Residual (by design): enrichment may still *replace* tags while `enrichment_status='pending'`
    (LLM refinement); all writers are race-guarded, so a client-enriched entry is never clobbered.

### DISC-3: `.drawio` not added to `INDEXABLE_EXTENSIONS` — Bug #4 half-delivered [High]

- **FSD says:** BR-16 — "`.drawio` extension MUST be added to `INDEXABLE_EXTENSIONS` in
  `indexer-discovery.ts`"; UC-04 main flow step 2 "discovers `.drawio` files".
- **Actual codebase:** the fix was applied only to the **backend temp walk** in
  `handleIngestDocsFromTemp` (`entry.name.endsWith('.drawio')`, STATUS.json Bug #4). The
  extension's `INDEXABLE_EXTENSIONS` (`extension/src/indexer-discovery.ts`) still lacks `.drawio`,
  and `FOLDER_DENYLIST` excludes `diagrams/`. Since `DocumentIndexer.run()` uses
  `discoverDocuments()` from that file, `.drawio` files are never discovered → never staged →
  the backend `.drawio` branch is unreachable through the normal flow.
- **Impact:** BR-16/BR-18/BR-19 not satisfied end-to-end; UC-04 acceptance (TC-21) will fail at
  discovery level; `.drawio` diagrams remain unindexed in KB.
- **Recommended fix (BA + DEV):** add `".drawio"` to `INDEXABLE_EXTENSIONS` and define its
  classification (`format: 'drawio'`) in `classifyFile()`, keeping the `diagrams/` denylist rule
  (BR-17). Re-run TC-21/TC-22.

### DISC-4: Two divergent type-derivation tables (client vs server) [Medium]

- **FSD says:** single `DOCUMENT_TYPES` mapping in `indexer-discovery.ts` with types
  `REQUIREMENT, ARCHITECTURE, PROCEDURE, DOCUMENTATION, CONTEXT`, incl. `DISCREPANCY* →
  DOCUMENTATION` and `SECURITY-REPORT* → DOCUMENTATION` (§3.1.3).
- **Actual codebase:** two implementations:
  (a) extension `DOCUMENT_TYPES` — `DISCREPANCY → CONTEXT`, `SECURITY-REPORT → PROCEDURE`,
  no `DOCUMENTATION`;
  (b) server `inferTypeFromPath` — regex `^(BRD|FSD)→REQUIREMENT`, `^TDD→ARCHITECTURE`,
  `^(STP|STC|DPG|RLN|UG|RUN-LOG)→PROCEDURE`, else `CONTEXT` — **no** `TEST-REPORT` rule, no
  `DOCUMENTATION`. The server value is what persists (the client `type` is not sent/stored).
- **Impact:** client-side classification shown during discovery can differ from stored KB type
  (e.g. `TEST-REPORT.md` → PROCEDURE in extension, CONTEXT in KB). BR-03 "single source of truth"
  is violated.
- **Recommended fix (BA):** declare the server function authoritative, align FSD table with
  `inferTypeFromPath`, and either remove or synchronise the extension table.

### DISC-5: Ticket-key tag pattern hardcoded to `SA4E` [Medium]

- **FSD says:** BR-07 — generic pattern `{PROJECT}-{NUMBER}` (uppercase letters + digits), with
  examples like `GRAPH-EMAIL` treated as a group.
- **Actual codebase:** both `extractTagsFromPath` (server) and `TaskWorker.fallbackTagExtraction`
  use `/^SA4E-\d+$/i` (plus `/^F\d+$/i` for features). Non-`SA4E` ticket folders (e.g. `KSA-26`)
  yield **no** ticket tag.
- **Impact:** multi-project workspaces (or renamed project keys) silently lose ticket tags —
  undermines BR-06/BR-11 intent and cross-project KB search.
- **Recommended fix (BA/DEV):** generalise to `/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-\d+$/i` (or read the project key
  from config), in both locations.

### DISC-6: Tag extraction specified client-side; implemented server-side [Medium]

- **FSD says:** UC-02 main flow — the *Indexer Extension* calls `extractTagsFromPath(relativePath,
  ticket)` and attaches `tags: string[]` to `DocEntry` (§3.2.2, §4.2 DocEntry attributes include
  `tags`, `relativePath`).
- **Actual codebase:** `DocEntry` (`IndexerHttpClient.ts`) is
  `{ path, type, ticket, format?, content? }` — **no `tags`, no `relativePath`, no `fileName`**;
  extraction happens in the backend `handleIngestDocsFromTemp` from the temp file path.
- **Impact:** FSD data model (§4.2) and use-case steps do not match the interface DEV implemented;
  QA cannot assert on a client-side `tags` field.
- **Recommended fix (BA):** update FSD §3.2.2 steps 1–7 and §4.2 to describe server-side
  extraction from the staged path; drop `tags`/`relativePath` from the DocEntry spec (or mark
  them as not part of the wire contract).

### DISC-7: Fallback tag extraction — different trigger [Low] — ⚠️ PARTIAL

- **FSD says:** §3.5 — fallback is invoked by `extractTagsFromPath()` when no ticket-key pattern is
  found in the folder; uses the immediate parent folder name (BR-20..BR-24), denylist-aware.
- **Actual codebase (post fix round 1):** `extractFallbackTags()` (exported,
  `backend/src/modules/memory/task-queue/TaskWorker.ts:69`, applied by `fallbackTagExtraction`)
  implements **BR-20..BR-24 literally**:
  - **BR-20** parent-folder fallback — nearest **non-denylisted** ancestor folder
    (`TaskWorker.ts:87`); a denylisted parent falls through to its grandparent (FSD EF-2 / TC-16);
  - **BR-21** root-level file → `documents` tag (`TaskWorker.ts:90`, FSD TC-11);
  - **BR-22** dedup — merged against `payload.existing_tags`, never duplicated;
  - **BR-23** `FALLBACK_TAG_DENYLIST` (`TaskWorker.ts:48`) — denylisted names never become tags
    (superset of FSD `FOLDER_DENYLIST`, see TDD §16.1 **R4** note);
  - **BR-24** nothing derivable → `unknown` sentinel (`TaskWorker.ts:116`);
  - content heuristics (`#### STORY` → `user-story`, `## Architecture` → `architecture`, …) are
    additive, on top of the path tags.
  Location differs from FSD (backend `TaskWorker` vs client `extractTagsFromPath`) — that part of
  the original finding still stands (see DISC-6).
- **Impact:** BR-20..BR-24 are now testable as written — UT `TaskWorker.fallback-tag.test.ts`
  covers EF-2 fall-through, denylist, `documents` root, `unknown`, dedup (12/12 PASS, re-run
  2026-10-05); IT `ingest-file-tags-fallback.it.test.ts` 3/3 PASS end-to-end.
- **Status — ⚠️ PARTIAL:**
  - **Done:** BR-20..BR-24 behaviour implemented literally (parent-folder / denylist / `documents`
    root / dedup / `unknown`), evidence above.
  - **Still open (owner: BA):** the **trigger** — the fallback runs when the **LLM `tagAnalyzer`
    is unavailable**, not "when no ticket-key is found in the path" as FSD §3.5 states. Behaviour
    is a superset (path+content heuristics also run on LLM-down for any file), but §3.5's trigger
    wording and the UC-05 flow steps still do not match the code.
- **Recommended fix (BA):** rewrite FSD §3.5 — trigger = "LLM `tagAnalyzer` unavailable / health
  check failing"; inputs = `payload.source` (path segments) + `payload.content` (heuristics) +
  `payload.existing_tags` (dedup); note client-side vs worker-side location. Keep this DISC **open**
  until FSD §3.5 is updated; then re-run TC-14..TC-16.

### DISC-8: `DOCUMENTATION` type does not exist [Low]

- **FSD says:** type enum includes `DOCUMENTATION` (§3.1.4 input data; mapping table rows for
  `DISCREPANCY*` and `SECURITY-REPORT*`).
- **Actual codebase:** backend knowledge types used here are `REQUIREMENT | ARCHITECTURE |
  PROCEDURE | CONTEXT` (extension also emits `DOCUMENTATION` nowhere — its table maps those two
  prefixes to `CONTEXT` / `PROCEDURE`).
- **Impact:** FSD enum overstates valid values; QA negative tests may expect `DOCUMENTATION`.
- **Recommended fix (BA):** remove `DOCUMENTATION` from FSD type enum, or implement it consistently
  end-to-end (then also extend `tierForType`).

### DISC-9: `TAG_ENRICHMENT` payload missing `source` — fallback path tags dead in production [High] — ✅ RESOLVED (fix round 1)

- **Origin:** TA re-review (round 2) of the F4 fallback path — not visible in FSD §3.5 text itself,
  but a violation of its contract (fallback derives tags **from the document path**).
- **FSD says:** §3.5 / UC-05 / BR-20..BR-21 — fallback tags come from the document path
  (immediate parent folder / ticket key), i.e. the enrichment job must carry the entry's `source`.
- **Actual codebase (pre fix round 1):** every `TAG_ENRICHMENT` payload was
  `{ entry_id, content, existing_tags, options }` — **no `source` key**. `extractFallbackTags()`
  therefore had no path to read (`payload.source` undefined → empty segments). With the LLM down —
  the *dominant* path (TDD §9.2: fallback is the everyday case while LLM health-check fails) —
  entries received only content-heuristic tags and **never** `sa4e` / `sa4e-337` / doc-type path
  tags → BR-06/BR-11/BR-20 violated in production.
- **Why tests missed it:** UT fixtures constructed payloads by hand *including* `source`, so the
  path branch passed; only the real payload-creation sites were broken (silent, production-only).
- **Impact:** High — path/ticket tags dead exactly in the scenario the fallback exists for.
- **Status — ✅ RESOLVED (dev fix round 1):** `source` added to **all 4** payload creators:
  1. generic `mem_ingest_file` create — `backend/src/modules/memory/dispatchers/crud.ts:89`
  2. `handleIngestFile` (ingest-docs route, F1) — `backend/src/modules/memory/dispatchers/crud.ts:285`
  3. admin KB re-enrich — `backend/src/server/routes/admin/kb-entries.ts:151`
  4. analytics bulk re-enrich — `backend/src/modules/memory/dispatchers/analytics.ts:71`

  **Evidence:** IT `backend/src/modules/memory/ingest/__tests__/ingest-file-tags-fallback.it.test.ts`
  — **3/3 PASS** (real dispatcher/adapter/worker on SQLite; case 1 asserts tags derived from
  `payload.source` = `.../SA4E-337/...` → `sa4e` + `sa4e-337` even when the caller sent no tags),
  re-run together with `TaskWorker.fallback-tag.test.ts` → **15/15 PASS** on 2026-10-05.
- **Recommended fix (BA, optional):** document `source` (and `existing_tags`) in the FSD §3.5
  payload contract so the wire shape is testable from the spec.
